note: Jet convergence on compacts (`travels_jet`, `comparison_jets`), the minimality gap of `summit` and the clock limit in `Scribe` are present, the jets obtained from the hypothesis `Approaches` and not by bounded left inverses of tested free responses. The translation-shell flux limit and the adjustable bound are not stated.

snippet.text:
lemma travels_jet (H : S.Hierarchy) (h : W.Derivatives S) (L : (Bel C.book).Hierarchy) (hp : V.Derivatives (Bel C.book))
    (X : Scaling S) (ht : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) (v : ℕ → Ribbon (Bel C.book) t) (x : Ribbon (Bel C.book) t)
    (hv : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun k => v k i) atTop (𝓝 (x i)))
    (j : ℕ) (s : Set (Points n)) (hs : IsCompact s) (hu : s ⊆ conf n) (ε : ℝ) (he : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ y∈s,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (tested (X.r k) (isoPanel X k) (hang t (v k))) y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (disc (hang t x)) y‖ ≤ ε := by

proof_context.conclusion: For inputs v_k tending to x, every fixed derivative of the tested rescaled correlation converges uniformly on compact subsets of `conf n` to that of `disc`.

snippet.text:
lemma comparison_jets (H : S.Hierarchy) (h : W.Derivatives S) (L : (Bel C.book).Hierarchy) (hp : V.Derivatives (Bel C.book))
    (X : Scaling S) (ht : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) (N d m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hr : 0<R) : X.jets N d m R := by
  intro n _ j _ v hv ε he
  exact travels_jet H h L hp X ht (t:=fun i => (v i).1) (fun _ i => (v i).2) (fun i => (v i).2)
    (fun _ => tendsto_const_nhds) j _ (window_closed ..) (fun _ h => spaced_conf (inv_pos.mpr hr) h.1) ε he

proof_context.conclusion: Gives `Scaling.jets`: all derivative orders up to m of the rescaled correlation converge to the Maxwell one on windows of Conf_n.

snippet.text: lemma gstar : Gate (A.clock.hatBeta i) ≤ gap A i (summit A i):=(Nat.find_spec <| goal A i).2

proof_context.conclusion: Minimality of `summit` gives the gap bound `Gate (hatBeta i)` ≤ gap, the (log beta)^48 separation.
